messages:
marcos: Quick sync proposal  start a POC with VaultCorp + OneLogin for SSO + HSM-backed keywrap. Scope: SAML SSO (SP and IdP flows), SCIM provisioning, and KMS/HSM wrap/unwrap for secrets. Suggested dates: next Tue or Thu. Who's available?

priya: I'm available Tue. Need to decide required SCIM attributes up front recommend: userName, email, displayName, userType, externalId. Also want group sync for role-based access.

alex: Eng note: we can support both SP and IdP initiated SAML. For HSM integration, we need to pick between REST keywrap vs PKCS#11/BYOK. PKCS#11 will add extra ops work.

sophie: Security preference: BYOK in HSM for enterprise deals, with attestation artifacts and immutable rotation logs. Also list required audit events and retention targets.

marcos: @liz_vaultcorp can you confirm VaultCorp's recommended integration path and share API examples? Also SLA for key operations and rotation windows.

liz_vaultcorp: liz_vaultcorp: We support REST keywrap for cloud customers and PKCS#11 for on-prem appliances. We'll share the API spec and a sample cURL for wrap/unwrap, plus our security whitepaper and compliance matrix.

marcos: sample cURL would be great so Alex can prototype quickly.

alex: Will start prototype against REST wrap endpoint once spec is received. Plan: simple wrap/unwrap, and then a rotation script. Target: 2w prototype.

priya: For SCIM, Ill draft mapping and group sync rules this week. Include a flag to exclude contractors from prod roles.

sophie: I'll check legal for retention requirements (90d vs 1y) and loop back. Also we should emit provisioning and key events to our event bus for traceability.

marcos: Action items: 1) @liz_vaultcorp send API spec + whitepaper by EOD Thu. 2) @alex prototype REST wrap in 2w. 3) @priya share SCIM map this week. 4) @sophie confirm retention with legal. I'll book the joint call for Tue 10am PT and attach a draft PoC checklist. React with :thumbsup: if good.

liz_vaultcorp: ack  will send docs. :white_check_mark:

alex: ack, starting tomorrow.

priya: ack. Will ping if gaps.

sophie: ack  involving legal.

deploybot: Reminder: partnership-onboarding template created at https://redwood-internal.example.com/docs/partnerships/vaultcorp-onprem (auto message)

marcos: Thanks all  I'll share calendar invite and initial diagram + PoC checklist before the call.
